## Selected Work

1. **AI Caller — AI Phone Agent SaaS** (2025 – present, founder & engineer). Multi-tenant platform where a business points a phone number at the service and gets an AI agent that answers calls in a natural voice, grounded in that tenant's own documents. Twilio Media Streams bridged to Deepgram's Voice Agent API over asyncio WebSockets, retrieval over PostgreSQL pgvector, Laravel + Inertia/Vue admin. Sub-second response latency, three-layer anti-hallucination design. https://hassanrao.com/projects/ai-caller
2. **Multi-Tenant Logistics SaaS Platform** (2021 – present, senior engineer). Shipment operations for 15 branches across three countries, thousands of shipments a day. Microservices, carrier integrations (DHL, AJEX, iMile) over OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine flows, event-driven work on AWS Lambda and SQS, 99.9% uptime. https://hassanrao.com/projects/logistics-platform
3. **AI Shipment Data Entry Automation** (2024). Generative-AI extraction that reads inbound paperwork and writes structured records into the platform, removing roughly six hours of manual keying per day. Confidence-scored with a human review queue. https://hassanrao.com/projects/ai-data-entry-automation
4. **High-Throughput Translation Management API** (2023). Laravel/PHP 8.2 REST API with Redis tag-based cache invalidation and cursor-based export across millions of records in constant memory. OAuth 2.0, full PHPUnit coverage. https://hassanrao.com/projects/translation-api

## Experience

- **Senior Software Engineer**, Thiqa Tech (Dec 2021 – present) — built a multi-tenant logistics SaaS deployed across Oman, the UAE and Saudi Arabia supporting 15 branches; automated shipment data entry with generative AI, removing ~6 hours of manual effort daily; integrated DHL, AJEX and iMile over OAuth 2.0; architected event-driven services on AWS Lambda, SQS and S3; maintained 99.9% uptime.
- **Founder & Engineer**, AI Caller (2025 – present) — designed, built and operate an AI phone receptionist SaaS end to end.
- **Freelance Full Stack Developer**, Fiverr & Upwork (2020 – 2021) — Top Rated seller, 250+ five-star reviews, 200+ clients across the US, Canada, Europe and Asia.
